stations.title: Dougie
stations.note: The check named what was flat.

captions: At the kit store, a callout comes in and Dougie asks whether everything is ready.
Today every kind of kit is checked the same way, and a flat battery goes up the hill.
You build a rope on kit, give it its own label, pick out the ropes and check the lot.
Now the check asks each item itself, and stops on the flat radio battery by name.
Every kind of kit answers for itself, and nothing flat or used leaves the store.
